observations.description: Per-component heartbeat_rpo_seconds on ComponentIdentityV1: None=use policy default, positive int=component-specific, zero/negative/bool=reject. Propagated to ComponentObservationV1.
evaluate_operational_readiness uses per-observation heartbeat_rpo_seconds if supplied, else policy default. BTC 90s SLA independent of ES/NQ 93600s SLA.
No Register/Unregister/Enable/Disable/Start/Stop-ScheduledTask, Start/Stop-Process, Set-ScheduledTask, New-ScheduledTask, Invoke-WebRequest/RestMethod/Expression/Command. Read-only collection only.

Get-TaskFacts: exact task name, single action, Get-ActionScript -File parsing (case-insensitive, quoted/unquoted), executable, state, last_result, MultipleInstances, RestartCount, RestartInterval, instance_count.
Get-Sha256 uses Get-FileHash with SHA256 algorithm. Source hashes derived from actual evidence files (btcEvent, btcManifest, latestEsRun).
Test-BtcIntegrity: missing manifest returns False, state==RECORDING checked, each checksum verified via Get-Sha256 comparison. Join-Path with Split-Path parent prevents traversal.
clock_skew_seconds = [int]::MaxValue — absent clock authority deliberately fails closed. No unauthenticated override possible.
ES/NQ archive_integrity_verified hardcoded $false until separately verified. Cannot be overridden through the collector.
Sanitized JSON: exact key set enforced (set(row) != required → reject). trading_authority must be False. incident_facts must be empty. Extra/missing fields reject.
Output is atomic (WriteAllText to temp + Move-Item), UTF-8 ([Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)), ConvertTo-Json. No credentials in source.
evaluate_sanitized_owner_facts: deterministic, trading_authority=False always, report_json sorted-keys canonical JSON with trailing newline.
No os/subprocess/socket/requests/httpx/win32com/ctypes imports. Pure read-only translation boundary.

corrected: heartbeat_rpo_seconds=None in identity propagates as None to observation (not policy default); policy default used only in staleness check
Lambda with assignment is invalid Python syntax → replaced with named function
redundant: Some PowerShell source assertions overlap with existing collector tests
